item.title: The Biggest Mistakes People Make When Taking a Career Break - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: In 2021, I left a six-figure, fully remote job in social media to take a sabbatical — to travel, grow, and reset — but it hasn't come without its realizations. Here's how I planned a purposeful, budget-focused career break, made the most of my time off, and avoided the biggest career break mistakes.

item.title: Battling the Choice Paradox: How I Decide Where to Go as a Nomad - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: They’ve escaped the office. They’ve minimized their belongings. They’ve designed their life for freedom. So why, in the middle of all this freedom, does it still feel like something’s missing? This is the paradox many nomads, slow travelers, and location-independent folks bump up against: the more options you have, the harder it becomes to feel satisfied with any one of them. Here's what I think about it all.

item.title: I Just Turned 40: How I’ve Changed Over the Last Decade - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: I spent my 40th birthday on a sailboat in Greece, with a few friends around me, feeling so wonderfully blessed to be living the life I lead… …thankful for the freedom of location independence, flexible and fulfilling entrepreneurship, and the self-love and presence of mind to (almost) always put myself first. item.title: Truth Bombs I’m Dropping after the Implosion of My Most Recent Serious Relationship - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: In February, I announced the end of my serious relationship on social media. But what my readers probably don’t know is that my boyfriend and I quietly got back together soon afterwards, and stayed together. Until now: it’s over. In keeping with my typical perspective of endless optimism and staying true to myself, here’s the final: my best and latest attempt at the bright side, the glass half full, the lessons learned and my core values revalidated. 💔 This is my most vulnerable, raw, and emotio

item.title: Seriously, Sri Lanka: My Travel Guide for a Week (or More) in Sri Lanka - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: Sri Lanka is quickly emerging as Asia’s rising star. Hear why I think this fast-growing standout travel destination should be on every adventurer's short list — and discover how to explore its beaches, culture, tea country, and wildlife with my 11-day itinerary.

item.title: The Hardest Lesson I’ve Ever Learned: A Breakup Post-Mortem and the Cost of Ignoring My Intuition - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: It was never paranoia. It was premonition. My intuition already knew what didn't make logical sense. The most painful lesson I’ve had to learn during the most meaningful relationship of my life? The most dangerous man a woman can love is the one who feels so empty inside he’ll do anything — drink, lie, seek attention, cheat — to feel better... that he will destroy the person he claims to value most in the world. No more Instagram vs. reality — here's what I've been dealing with the past year.

item.title: How Traveling the World Has Actually Transformed Me: 15 Surprising Ways Travel Has Changed How I See Everything - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: What does "transformative travel" mean exactly? I hear it a lot, without any kind of explanation — so let me tell you what it's NOT. Transformational travel isn’t about “finding yourself”... Or counting countries like it’s a competitive sport or some mark of honor... It's about unlearning what you were taught. If travel hasn’t challenged your assumptions, it didn’t transform you — it just entertained you. More hot takes inside.

item.title: I Spent HOW MUCH As a Global Nomad in 2025? Plus, How Barista FIRE Works in Practice - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: Ever since I went nomadic, I’ve shared honest spending updates on my blog — real looks at how I make this lifestyle work financially — and this year is no exception! So how much did it actually cost to travel to every continent in 2025? (Spoiler: more than last year.) I’m not fully retired, not hustling, and definitely not living in hostels anymore. Read on for how 'Barista FIRE' actually plays out for me in real life, and what freedom looks like without extreme frugality.

item.title: What I Lost in a Nomadic Lifestyle (and How Bringing People Together Healed It) - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: Nomad life gave me freedom and adventure — but I found myself craving lasting connection. I wasn’t missing people. I was missing people who stayed. So, in a life built for movement, I decided to do something about it. This is how I created connection, community, and friendship by organizing group trips.

item.title: How I Stopped Using Money to Accumulate — and Started Using It to Be Free - juliedevivre.com by Julie B. Rose
item.description: I used to think wealth meant earning and having more. So I followed the script — climb the career ladder, build the résumé, buy the things, look the part. The problem wasn’t that I failed. It’s that succeeding didn’t feel like freedom. This is how I redefined wealth as ownership of time — and why that changed my life.
